evidence.dom: 10-K FY2025(tt-20251231.htm) Item1 Competitive Conditions: 『Our products and services are sold in highly competitive markets throughout the world. Due to the diversity of these products and services and the variety of markets served, we encounter a wide variety of competitors that vary by product line and services. They include well-established regional or specialized competitors, as well as larger U.S. and non-U.S. corporations or divisions of larger companies. ... We are one of the leading manufacturers in the world of HVAC systems and services and transport temperature control products and services.』 Item1A Risk Factors『The markets that we serve are highly competitive. We compete worldwide with a number of other manufacturers and distributors that produce and sell similar products. ... Due to our global footprint we are competing worldwide with large companies and with smaller, local operators who may have customer, regulatory or economic advantages in the geographies in which they are located.』。**自社シェア%の開示なし／上位N社合計シェアの開示なし／競合の実名列挙すらなし**——原本に数値が存在しないため70/85/100は主張不能(『one of the leading manufacturers』は順位の自称＝v9.9.41規約4によりどの刻みの証拠にもならない)。他方、提出書類自身が「a wide variety of competitors that vary by product line」「large companies and with smaller, local operators」「a number of other manufacturers and distributors that produce and sell **similar products**」と、同等品を多数が供給する**構造的な分散**を述べており、自社40%以上・上位2社≥80%・上位3社≥80%のいずれも原本からは成立しない → 市場構造=競争(<40%)＝刻み50。Americas/EMEA/Asia Pacificの3セグメントに区別なく同一の記述が置かれ全社が同じ刻みに落ちるため50を確定(v9.9.41規約1・3)
evidence.moatW: セグメント別売上: 10-K FY2025(2025-12-31) Note—Segment Results / Item1 Reportable Segments 総売上 21,321.9百万$ = Americas 17,168.8(80.5%) / EMEA 2,802.1(13.1%) / Asia Pacific 1,351.0(6.3%)。**報告セグメントは地域区分のみ**で、原本の記述もAmericas『commercial heating, cooling and ventilation systems, building controls and solutions, and energy services and solutions; residential heating and cooling; and transport refrigeration systems and solutions』/EMEA『heating, cooling and ventilation systems and services, energy services and solutions, and transport refrigeration systems and solutions』/Asia Pacific『heating, cooling and ventilation systems, services and solutions for commercial buildings and transport refrigeration systems and solutions』と、**同一の製品・同一の技術(空調/温度制御)を地域別に売っているだけ**＝地域は独立した堀ではない。ブランドも『These products are sold primarily under our tradenames including Trane and Thermo King』の2つのみで、いずれも冷媒・熱交換・圧縮機という共通中核技術に乗る(v9.9.41追加規約で1本)。Item1 Customers『We have no single external customer that accounted for more than 10% of our consolidated net revenues in 2025, 2024 or 2023』＝最大顧客<10%。10-Kは製品ライン別売上を開示しないため『1製品≥80%』(→50)の根拠も『第2の堀≥15%(Thermo King単独)』(→85)の根拠も取れない。 → 単一事業だが用途・顧客・地域が分散(最大顧客<10%)＝70。85には上げない

nulls.p3: 【2026-07-29】規約どおり空欄へ戻した。p3 は門が nde=0.54 から同表で導出する（純現金→95 / <1→85 / <2.5→70 / 以上→50）。台帳にあった 85 は導出値と一致していたので、値を置いておく意味が無い——むしろ値が残っていると門はそれを『逸脱評価』として尊重し、nde を直しても p3 が追随しなくなる（陳腐化する）。審査プロトコル『ndeを埋めれば空欄可＝門が機械導出』。
nulls.f5: 【2026-07-29】規約どおり空欄へ戻した。f5 は門が disrupt='settled' から同表で導出する（settled→85 / unsettled→65 / threat→45）。台帳にあった 85 は導出値と一致していたので、値を置いておく意味が無い——むしろ値が残っていると門はそれを『逸脱評価』として尊重し、disrupt を直しても f5 が追随しなくなる（陳腐化する）。審査プロトコル『disruptを埋めれば空欄可＝門が機械導出』。
